blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Within the CG animation production pipeline, the challenges artists tackle in Lighting can be immense. Even minor adjustments require re-rendering massive scenes with slow offline renderers; global illumination has to be sampled and complex shaders have to be evaluated, leading to iteration times of minutes to hours per frame. To accelerate this process, we introduce a novel neural render proxy (NRP) that enables differentiable relighting of static scenes with fixed camera and materials at interactive rates. Our main insight is the decoupling of traditional rendering into path sampling and emission computation. From a single, light-agnostic render pass, we collect light transport data in the form of path samples. This enables rapidly sampling lighting conditions on the fly, and training a scene-specific lightweight neural network that learns how light is transported from any scene location to any image pixel. This approach is compatible with non-differentiable production renderers, induces minimal memory requirements during inference, and scales only with resolution and the number of light sources and parameters, but independently of scene and appearance complexity. Our evaluation demonstrates interactive frame rates for relighting (~30-60 Hz) while closely approximating the visual fidelity of ground-truth path tracing. In addition, the differentiable NRP enables fast, gradient-based inverse workflows, allowing artists to efficiently solve for lighting parameters from intuitive image-space edits or generative targets.
blocks.zh: 在CG动画制作管道中,艺术家们在照明中应对的挑战可能是巨大的. 即使是小的调整,也需要用慢的离线渲染器重新投放大面积场景;全球照明必须取样,复杂的遮阳器必须加以评价,导致每个帧的重复时间为分钟到小时. 为了加快这一过程,我们引入了一个新的神经渲染代用(NRP),能够以互动的速度用固定的相机和材料对静态场景进行可变的重燃. 我们的主要见解是将传统渲染与路径取样和排放计算脱钩。 从一个单一的,光不可知的渲染通过,我们以路径样本的形式收集光传输数据. 这使得能迅速取样苍蝇上的照明条件,并训练一个场景特有的轻量级神经网络,学习光如何从任何场景位置传送到任何图像像素. 这种方法与无差别的制作渲染器兼容,在推论过程中诱导最小的内存要求,尺度只与分辨率以及光源和参数的数量相适应,但独立于场景和外观复杂性. 我们的评价显示,重燃(~30-60赫兹)的交互式帧率,同时密切接近地面-真实路径追踪的视觉可靠性。 此外,不同的NRP可以快速,基于梯度的反向工作流程,使艺术家能够从直观的图像空间编辑或基因目标中有效解决照明参数.

blocks.en: We train a compact network to predict transport through the scene arriving at sensor locations using light-agnostic path data, allowing us to relight complex scenes. Our model is interactive, has a modest memory footprint, generates high-quality and temporally coherent shading, and is differentiable, admitting image-driven lighting parameter optimization through otherwise non-differentiable production renderers. © Disney
blocks.zh: 我们训练一个紧凑的网络 来预测到达感应地点的运输 利用光不可知的路径数据 来重新点亮复杂的场景 我们的模型是交互式的,具有适度的内存足迹,产生高质量和时间上一致的阴影,并且是不同的,通过否则无差别的制作渲染器承认图像驱动的照明参数优化. ©. 迪士尼岛

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: High-fidelity lighting in production environments is inherently iterative and slow. Fine-tuning lighting typically happens at the very end of the production pipeline, i.e., once materials, camera and geometry are fixed. However, even minor edits at this stage require iteration times of minutes to hours due to frame or sequence re-renders. This bottleneck is compounded by the fact that current production pipelines are effectively one-way streets: They generate images from scene parameters, but cannot translate intuitive, image-space art direction back into the 3D scene. Since production renderers are usually non-differentiable, artists are trapped in a slow trial-and-error loop, as image-guided optimization of lighting parameters is not readily supported.
blocks.zh: 生产环境中的高性能照明具有内在的迭代性和缓慢性. 微调照明一般发生在生产管的一端,即一旦材料,相机和几何固定. 然而,即使是在这个阶段的小型编辑,由于帧或序列重排,也需要从分钟到小时的重复时间. 目前的生产管道实际上都是单向的: 它们从场景参数生成图像,但不能将直观的,图像空间的艺术方向再翻译为3D场景. 由于出品渲染器通常是无差别的,艺术家被困在一个缓慢的试验和过敏回路中,因为对照明参数的图像引导优化并不容易支持.

blocks.en: Prior work on interactive relighting has largely relied on image-space post-processing (e.g., compositing), generative image synthesis methods, or interactive renderers. While compositing is an essential tool in production pipelines, it is fundamentally an image-space operation, limiting the light edits it supports. Generative AI attempts to bridge this gap in image space, but, while visually impressive, struggles to faithfully represent physical interactions and lacks controllability, limiting its use for lighting. Conversely, while modern production relies on physically accurate path tracing [ Pha18 ] , interactive path tracing systems do not scale yet to the geometric and material complexity of production scenes. Consequently, digital lighting artists have no viable way to reconcile fast iteration with the requirement for physically accurate, production-scale rendering.
blocks.zh: 以前关于交互再光的工作主要依靠图像空间后处理(如相容),基因图像合成方法,或交互式渲染器. 虽然堆肥是生产管线中不可或缺的工具,但从根本上来说,它是一种图像-空间操作,限制了它所支持的光编辑. Generative AI试图弥合图像空间的这一差距,但虽然在视觉上令人印象深刻,但努力忠实地代表了物理相互作用并缺乏可控性,限制了它用于照明. 反之,虽然现代生产依赖于物理上准确的路径追踪[Pha18],但交互式路径追踪系统还没有达到生产场景的几何和材料上的复杂性. 因此,数字照明艺术家没有可行的办法调和快速迭代与物理准确、生产规模渲染的要求。

blocks.en: We introduce neural render proxy (NRP), an approach to interactive lighting for static scenes with fixed views that bridges the gap between high-fidelity path tracing and interactive scene- and image-space light manipulation. Our key insight is that decoupling the expensive light transport simulation from final pixel synthesis allows us to cache complex physical interactions into a highly compressed, relightable representation. By acting directly on path vertices and throughput weights generated by an offline path tracer, we train a compact multi-layer perceptron (MLP) that maps parameters of standard light sources, like sphere lights or quad lights, to their effect in the image plane. This lightweight representation enables interactive re-rendering with dynamic lighting configurations at runtime, while faithfully synthesizing complex light transport and scaling independently of scene geometry and material complexity.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了神经渲染代用(NRP),这是一种用固定视图为静态场景提供互动照明的方法,它弥合了高真实度路径追踪与交互式场景和图像空间光线操纵之间的空隙. 我们的关键见解是,将昂贵的光传输模拟与最终像素合成脱钩,使我们能够将复杂的物理相互作用缓存到一个高度压缩,可再光化的表示. 通过直接在离线路径跟踪器生成的路径顶点和吞吐量重量上行动,我们训练出一个紧凑的多层受体(MLP)来将标准光源的参数如球形灯光或四相灯等映射到图像平面上的效果. 这种轻量级的表示可以在运行时与动态照明配置进行交互重放,同时忠实地将复杂的光传输和缩放独立于场景几何和材料复杂度.

blocks.en: To attain interactive relighting without exorbitant pre-computation, our training scheme extracts rich supervision data from a single, light-agnostic rendering pass. This distinguishes our approach from prior image-based neural transport methods, which explicitly require the generation of many different lighting configurations in an expensive pre-pass [ ZFT∗21 ] . During training, we reuse our light-agnostic sample data to create training examples on-the-fly, massively reducing end-to-end turnaround times and memory footprint. Our efficient training scheme takes between tens of minutes and a few hours depending on scene complexity, allowing it to seamlessly integrate into standard overnight render cycles to be ready for interactive editing the next morning. Once trained, NRP compresses tens of gigabytes of raw path data into a few megabytes of network weights, which can be quickly loaded into memory and used for lighting at interactive frame rates (i.e., ∼ \sim 30–60 Hz), while maintaining temporal consistency across continuous edits.
blocks.zh: 为了在不进行过高的预判的情况下实现交互重放,我们的培训计划从一个单一的、轻而易举的渲染通过中提取出丰富的监督数据。 这区分了我们的方法与先前基于图像的神经传导方法,后者明确要求在昂贵的预通[ZFT*21]中生成许多不同的照明配置. 在训练期间,我们重新使用光不可知的样本数据,以创造飞行上的培训实例,并大量减少从端到端的周转时间和记忆足迹. 我们的高效训练计划需要数十分钟到几个小时,这取决于场景的复杂程度,使它能无缝地融入标准的一夜之间,使得周期可以准备在第二天早上进行互动编辑。 NRP经过训练后将数十千兆字节的原始路径数据压缩为几兆字节的网络重量,可以被快速地加载入内存并被以交互式帧速率(即\\sim 30–60 Hz)用于照明,同时保持连续编辑的时间一致性.

blocks.en: In addition, our resulting neural model is differentiable and allows us to back-propagate image-space losses to light parameters at interactive rates, enabling image-based light editing paradigms, including “light painting” and art direction guided by modern generative image synthesis tools.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们产生的神经模型是不同的,使我们能够以交互速率将图像-空间损失背向光参数,从而促成基于图像的光编辑范式,包括由现代基因图像合成工具指导的"光绘"和艺术取向.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are: • An efficient framework for re-using paths from path tracers for interactive relighting at production-quality accuracy. • A neural render proxy that compresses the samples by several orders of magnitude and enables inverse rendering applications. • A suite of tools based on our neural render proxy that demonstrate its applicability for art-directed and generative lighting.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,我们的贡献是: 一个高效的框架,用于从路径追踪器中重新使用路径,以交互方式重新点出生产质量准确性。 二. 支助 一个神经成像代理将样品压缩出数个数量级,并能够反向渲染应用. 二. 支助 一套基于我们的神经成像代理的工具 证明了它适用于艺术定向和基因照明

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Our Pipeline . Training (left): We collect lighting agnostic paths from path tracing the scene before generating denoised image with random lighting conditions to serve as training data. Our neural render proxy (NRP; middle) is a lightweight MLP with hashgrid positional encoding that predicts light transport to a sensor pixel from an input light. To reduce training time and avoid spectral bias, we condition the NRP on auxiliary features (albedo, depth and normals) at sensor image coordinates. At inference time (top right), we can relight the scene at interactive rates by inserting virtual light sources into the scene. Since the NRP is also differentiable, we can optimize for lighting parameters (bottom right) using gradient descent, driven by any number of image-space guidance approaches.
blocks.zh: 图1:我们的管道。 我们从追踪现场的路径收集照明可知性路径,然后生成带有随机照明条件的去诺化图像作为训练数据. 我们的神经渲染代理(NRP;中)是一个轻量级的MLP,有散列位置编码,预测从输入光线向传感器像素的光传输. 为了减少训练时间并避免光谱偏差,我们在传感器图像坐标上将NRP以辅助特征(albedo,深度和常态)作为条件. 在推论时间(右上方),可以通过将虚拟光源插入到场景中,以交互速率重新点出场景. 由于NRP也是不同的,我们可以利用由任意数量的图像-空间引导方法所驱动的梯度下降来优化照明参数(从下到右).

blocks.en:
Recent neural relighting methods leverage pretrained diffusion models for scene generalization, with intrinsic decompositions into albedo, normal, and shading or material property buffers [ ZDG∗24 , LCY∗24 , LDHG∗25 ] enabling finer relighting control.
User control has been extended to text-guided lighting [ ZRA25 ] , scribble-based guidance [ CWP∗25 ] , parametric light manipulation [ MHT∗25 ] , and intrinsics-based relighting [ XGK∗25 ] . Others condition on radiometric cues such as radiance hints [ ZDP∗24 ] , HDR environment maps [ EDG∗25 , JLL∗24 ] , or point lights [ BFB∗25 ] .
Closer to our setting, LightFormer [ RHP∗24 ] encodes virtual point lights into neural embeddings for real-time relighting of fully dynamic scenes, and RenderFormer [ ZDP∗25 ] uses transformers to render triangle meshes with global illumination without per-scene training, though it is limited to 4,096 triangles and a single BRDF model. Neither method supports volumetric transport, and neither has been applied to inverse lighting optimization.
blocks.zh:
近期的神经再光法利用预受训练的传播模型来进行场景通化,内在分解为反照率,常态,以及阴影或物质属性缓冲[ZDG*24,LCY*24,LDHG*25]能使更精细的再光控制.
用户控制被扩展至文本制导照明[ZRA25],以拼写为主的指导[CWP*25],参数光操控[MHT*25],以内在为主的再照明[XGK*25]. 其他条件以辐射测量提示为条件,如发光提示[ZDP*24],HDR环境图[EDG*25,JLL*24],或点灯[BFB*25].
更接近我们的设定,LightFormer [RHP*24]将虚拟点灯编码为神经嵌入,用于实时重燃全动态场景,而RenderFormer [ZDP*25]使用变压器将三角形中间点与全球发光制成而无需进行纯色训练,虽然它仅限于4,096个三角点和单一的BRDF模型. 这两种方法都没有支持体积迁移,也没有应用于反向照明优化.

blocks.en: Earlier learning-based methods train on large datasets of images rendered under many lighting configurations [ RDL∗15 , ZFT∗21 ] ; more recent work improves generalization via self-supervised inverse rendering [ CA25 ] or shadow-aware single-image relighting [ GRP22 ] . Despite their flexibility, most of these approaches rely on generative priors that do not adhere to production art direction and offer limited guarantees on the physical consistency of complex transport effects (caustics, inter-reflections), and are incompatible with the physics-based light transport parametrizations of production rendering workflows.
blocks.zh: 早期的以学习为基础的方法对在许多照明配置下所提供图像的大型数据集进行训练[RDL *15,ZFT *21];更近期的作品通过自我监督的反向渲染[CA25]或影子意识单相图重取光[GRP22]来改进概括. 这些方法尽管具有灵活性,但大多数都依赖于不坚持生产艺术取向,对复杂运输效果(caustics,inter-reflections)的物理一致性提供有限的保证的基因前传,并且与生产渲染工作流程的以物理为基础的光传输参数化不相容.

blocks.en:
Production path tracers require minutes to hours per frame, making interactive lighting iteration infeasible.
Real-time denoising and upscaling techniques reduce noise in low-sample renders but do not change the fundamental cost of re-tracing paths when lights move.
Spatiotemporal reservoir resampling [ BWP∗20 ] improves light sampling efficiency for direct illumination but still requires the full scene and renderer in the loop for each configuration.
Neural Radiance Caching (NRC) [ MRNK21 ] trains a small MLP online to predict radiance at path vertices, allowing early path termination and accelerating convergence within a running path tracer. Though conceptually related, NRC encodes the current lighting implicitly in its weights rather than accepting light parameters as input, so it cannot evaluate radiance under novel lighting without continued online training and provides no gradient path to light parameters for inverse optimization.
Path guiding methods [ MGN17 , HSRM25 ] improve sampling efficiency but likewise require full scene access and per-configuration re-tracing, and are not differentiable.
Our method decouples the renderer from inference entirely: Once the neural proxy is trained from a single light-agnostic rendering pass, the scene and renderer are no longer needed for either interactive forward relighting or differentiable inverse applications.
blocks.zh:
生产路径跟踪仪每帧需要几分钟到几小时,使交互式照明迭代不可行.
实时去诺和升级技术减少了低采样中的噪音,但不会改变灯光移动时再追踪路径的基本成本。
Spatiotemporal 水库再生 [BWP*20] 提高了光采样效率,用于直接发光,但仍需要每个配置的环中的全部场景和渲染器.
神经辐射 Caching (NRC) [MRNK21] 在线训练一款小型MLP来预测路径顶点的光度,可以使路径提前终止并加速运行路径跟踪器内的收相. NRC虽然在概念上相互关联,但它在权重中隐含地编码了当前照明,而不是接受光参数作为输入,因此它不能在没有继续在线训练的情况下评价新照明下的光度,也没有为反向优化提供光参数的梯度路径.
路径指导方法[MGN17,HSRM25]提高了采样效率,但同样要求全场取用和每个配置的再跟踪,并且没有不同.
我们的方法使渲染器与推论完全脱钩: 一旦神经代用器从单一的光不可知渲染传出口接受训练后,场景和渲染器就不再需要用于交互式前向再点光或不同的反向应用.

blocks.en: Production renderers are typically non-differentiable, ruling out gradient-based optimization of scene parameters from image-space objectives. Differentiable renderers address this gap through specialized automatic differentiation and just-in-time compilation [ JSR∗22 , JSRV22 ] , which incorporate adjoint methods such as radiative backpropagation [ NDSRJ20 ] and path replay backpropagation [ VSJ21 ] . Visibility discontinuities are commonly treated through explicit boundary sampling [ LADL18 ] , path-space boundary integrals [ ZMY∗20 ] , and warped-area reparameterization [ BLD20 , WMB∗25 ] ; these approaches require specialized boundary or auxiliary computations that add significant overhead. Lipp et al. [ LHEN∗24 ] specialize adjoint light tracing for view-independent lighting design optimization at interactive rates, but like all differentiable rendering methods discussed above, require full scene access and ray tracing at each gradient step, inheriting the computational challenges of forward rendering on production-scale scenes.
blocks.zh: 制作渲染器一般是无差别的,排除了从图像-空间目标中以梯度为基础的场景参数优化. 可分化的渲染器通过专门的自动分化和准时编译[JSR *22,JSRV22]解决了这一差距,其中纳入了辐射回放[NDSRJ20]和路径回放回放[VSJ21]等联合方法. 通常通过明确边界取样[LADL18]、路径-空间边界组成部分[ZMY*20]和被扭曲区域再参数化[BLD20、WMB*25]处理可见性不连续问题;这些方法需要专门边界或辅助计算,从而增加大量的间接费用。 李普等编. [LHEN*24] 专为取景独立照明设计以互动速率优化而进行联合光线跟踪,但和上文所讨论出的所有不同渲染方法一样,要求在每个梯度步骤上完全取景和射线跟踪,继承了生产尺度场景上向前渲染的计算挑战.

blocks.en: Neural inverse rendering methods [ BBJ∗21 , ZLW∗21 ] and differentiable Gaussian surfel approaches [ JSL∗25 ] are implicitly differentiable but do not capture full physics-based volumetric transport. Hadadan et al. [ HLN∗23 ] use a neural radiometric prior grounded in the rendering equation for inverse global illumination, but their method targets scene recovery rather than interactive relighting.
blocks.zh: 神经反向渲染方法[BBJ *21,ZLW *21]和相异的高斯冲浪方法[JSL *25]是隐含相异的,但不能捕捉到完全基于物理的体积迁移. 哈达丹等. [HLN*23]使用神经辐射测量法在渲染等式中先入为主,用于反向全球发光,但他们的方法目标是场景恢复而不是交互再光.

blocks.en: We are most closely inspired by methods that fit local neural surrogates (i.e., proxies) for small-step optimization to (non-differentiable) path tracing output [ FR24 ] or estimate higher-order gradients stochastically [ WFR25 ] . During optimization, however, the renderer and scene must remain in the loop: Each step re-renders the scene (at low sample counts) to update the local surrogate before taking a gradient step through it. Our method requires neither re-loading the full scene nor re-tracing rays after training, compressing tens of gigabytes of path data into a few megabytes of network weights within a modest time budget. Variance-aware inverse rendering [ YPD∗24 ] has recently been proposed to make the variance of Monte Carlo estimators itself differentiable and optimizable with respect to scene parameters. Our neural proxy avoids this problem entirely by producing noise-free, deterministic derivatives via standard backpropagation. This comes at a cost: The proxy is specific to a given scene and view, and introduces approximation bias from MLP regression, which we quantify in Section 4 .
blocks.zh: 我们受到最密切的启发的是,将局部神经代位(即代位)用于小步优化到(无差别的)路径跟踪输出[FR24]的方法,或者对高序梯度进行分解估计[WFR25]. 然而,在优化过程中,渲染器和场景必须保持回路: 每一步都重新给场景(以低样本计数)以更新本地代位后再采取梯度步骤通过. 我们的方法既不要求重新装入整个场景,也不要求在训练后重新追踪射线,在适度的时间预算中将数十千兆字节的路径数据压缩成几兆字节的网络重量. 最近有人提议将差异感反向渲染[YPD*24],以使蒙特卡洛估计器本身的差异在场景参数上是不同的和可选择的。 我们的神经代用通过标准的回放产生无噪声,有决定性的衍生物来完全避免这个问题. 其代价是: 代用是特定场景和视图的特有,并引入了MLP回归的近似偏差,我们在第四节中量化了这些偏差.

blocks.en: Methods that estimate lighting from images are commonly used for relighting and virtual object insertion. Early approaches rely on regressing the lighting parameters [ GSY∗17 ] , and recent works use generative priors to recover high-fidelity HDR environment maps: Diffusion models can estimate scene lighting directly [ LHG∗25 ] or via high-frequency reflective proxies [ PCS∗24 , TWZ25 ] , while other approaches use spatiotemporal representations [ SBD∗25 ] or joint geometry-material-lighting recovery [ WJZ∗25 ] . Environment map optimization has also been shown to benefit from diffusion-guided refinement [ LGND∗24 ] . UniLight proposes a lighting representation suitable for transferring lighting conditions across images [ ZGF∗25 ] . Whether parametric or map-based, these methods recover lighting from observations rather than providing interactive control over individual light parameters or inverse optimization from image-space objectives, which our approach enables.
blocks.zh: 从图像中估计照明的方法通常用于再照明和虚拟对象插入. 早期的方法依赖于照明参数的倒置[GSY*17],而近期的作品使用基因前传来恢复高可靠性的HDR环境图: 扩散模型可以直接[LHG*25]或通过高频反射代用[PCS*24,TWZ25]估算出场景照明,而其他方法则使用spatientpresentations[SBD*25]或联合几何-材料发光恢复[WJZ*25]. 环境图的优化也证明得益于传播指导的改进[LGND*24]。 UniLight提议一个适合将照明条件传出图像的照明代表[ZGF*25]. 这些方法无论是参数还是基于地图,都从观测中恢复照明,而不是从我们的方法所促成的图像空间目标中提供对单个光参数的交互控制或反向优化.

blocks.en: Precomputed radiance transfer (PRT) projects light transport onto a compact basis for rapid relighting [ KSL05 ] , with recent neural extensions improving flexibility but remaining restricted to distant environment map illumination [ RBRD22 , RXL∗23 ] . Instead of pre-integrating against a fixed basis, we cache raw transport structure (path vertices and throughput weights), enabling relighting with arbitrary lights and materials not expressible in any pre-integration basis, including local lights in scenes with participating media (volumes).
blocks.zh: 预计算出发光传输(PRT)项目将轻型运输推入一个紧凑的基础,以便快速再照明[KSL05],最近的神经外延提高了灵活性,但仍限于远距离环境图发光[RBRD22,RXL*23]。 我们不是在固定基础上进行预先整合,而是缓存原始运输结构(路径顶点和吞吐量重量),从而能够以任意的灯光和在任何预先整合的基础上无法表示的材料来重燃,包括在有参与媒介(量)的场景中的局部灯光.

blocks.en:
Interactive lighting in production has a long history predating modern path tracing.
Painting-based inverse systems trace back to Schoeneman et al. [ SDS∗93 ] , later generalized to nonlinear optimization over many light parameters via black-box renderer evaluation [ PBMF07 ] .
Complementary interfaces let artists directly manipulate shadows as first-class primitives [ PTG02 ] , and user studies have compared direct, indirect, and painting paradigms [ KP09 ] .
In parallel, deep-framebuffer relighting engines such as Lpics [ PVL∗05 ] and Lightspeed [ RKKS∗07 ] enabled interactive previews of production-scale RenderMan scenes by caching first-hit surface response and re-executing simplified light shaders on the GPU.
These systems were tied to the REYES era: direct illumination only, first-hit caches rather than full transport, strictly forward, and a bake invalidated by any change to camera, geometry, or shaders.
Modern productions have largely moved to fully path-traced pipelines [ Pha18 ] in part to escape this baking overhead, at the cost of re-rendering per edit.
Our method revisits this spirit for the path-traced era: a single light-agnostic pass yields a compact, differentiable proxy that captures multi-bounce transport and supports both interactive forward relighting and gradient-based inverse design.
blocks.zh:
生产中的互动照明有着悠久的历史,比现代路径追踪更早.
基于绘画的反向系统可追溯到Schoeneman等人[SDS*93],后被泛指为非线性优化,通过黑箱渲染器评价许多光参数[PBMF07].
补充界面让艺术家直接操纵影子作为一等原始人[PTG02],用户研究比较了直接,间接,和绘画范式[KP09].
同时,深帧缓冲器还重新点燃了Lpics[PVL*05]和Lightspeed[RKKS*07]等引擎,通过在GPU上缓冲一击地表响应和再起速的简化光荫器,使得生产规模的RenderMan场景能够进行互动预览.
这些系统与REYES时代捆绑在一起:只有直接发光,先发性缓存而不是完全传送,严格向前,而烘焙则被任何改变到相机,几何或遮光器而失效.
现代出品大多转向了完全路径跟踪管 [Pha18] 部分是为了逃避这种烘焙的间接费用,代价是每次编辑都要重新出品.
我们的方法为路径追踪时代重温了这种精神:一个单一的光不可知的通关产生一个紧凑的,可分化的代理,它能捕捉多弹跳的传输,并支持交互式前向再点亮和以梯度为基础的反向设计.

blocks.en: In summary, the methods above address complementary aspects of lighting design but leave fundamental gaps. In production, artists craft illumination by directly manipulating light parameters such as positions, intensities, and shapes, retaining full creative control at the cost of iteration speed. Research on accelerated rendering, efficient sampling, and denoising continues to narrow this gap and is indispensable, but the complexity of production scenes, with massive geometric complexity, complex global illumination, and intricate shading graphs, keeps physically grounded interactive editing out of reach. Generative and image-based methods offer intuitive, high-level control through prompts, scribbles, or reference images, but without grounding in the physical transport of the scene. The outputs of generative methods do not decompose into parametric light descriptions and cannot guarantee that a proposed edit is physically realizable.
blocks.zh: 总之,上述方法涉及照明设计的补充方面,但留下了根本的空白。 在制作中,艺术家通过直接操纵位置,强度等光参数和外形来进行发光,以重复速度为代价保留了完全的创造性控制. 关于加速渲染、高效采样和取名的研究继续缩小这一差距,是不可或缺的,但生产场景的复杂性,加上大量的几何复杂性、复杂的全球光线和复杂的阴影图,使实际存在的交互式编辑无法取得。 以基因和图像为基础的方法通过提示来提供直观的,高层次的控制,被打字,或者参考图像,但不会在现场的物理运输中被打倒. 基因方法的输出不会分解成参数光描述,不能保证一个拟议的编辑可以实际实现.

blocks.en: Our method bridges both: A single offline precomputation step yields a compact, differentiable neural proxy that provides interactive forward relighting with full parametric control, while its differentiability enables gradient-based translation of image-space objectives into scene lighting parameters.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法连接两个: 单一的离线前演算步骤产生一个紧凑而相异的神经代用,提供具有全参数控制的交互式前向再光,而其相异性则能将图像空间目标以梯度为基础被转换为场景照明参数.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: The traditional offline rendering pipelines for relighting of static scenes suffer from slow scene loading, long render times, and are typically non-differentiable. We replace this with a differentiable neural render proxy trained from data collected during a single rendering process that can predict images for arbitrary lighting configurations at interactive rates and is amenable to inverse rendering applications.
blocks.zh: 传统的离线渲染管道用于重新点出静态场景,造成场景加载速度缓慢,时间长,而且通常无差别. 我们用一个不同的神经成像代理来取代它,它从一个单一的渲染过程中收集的数据中训练出来,能够以交互速率预测任意照明配置的图像,并易于反向渲染应用。

blocks.en:
We begin by showing that in the context of forward path tracing and virtual lights,
rendering can be decoupled into path sampling, which requires scene but not light information, and emission computation, which requires light but no scene information ( Section 3.1 ).
This decoupling allows us to pre-compute path samples once, and reuse them for fast relighting with arbitrary light configurations, albeit at the cost of operating on large path sample dumps.
blocks.zh:
我们首先表明,在前进路径追踪和虚拟灯光方面,
渲染可以分解为路径取样,这需要场景而不是光线信息,以及排放计算,这需要光线而不是场景信息(第3.1节)。
这种脱钩使我们能够预先计算一次路径样品,再用它们来快速重燃任意的光线配置,尽管代价是在大型路径样品堆放地上操作.

blocks.en: To reduce memory requirements and support differentiability, we introduce our neural render proxy ( Section 3.2 ), which encodes the paths’ sample information in a compressed, continuous, and differentiable representation, enabling applications such as art-directed edits and generative relighting.
blocks.zh: 为了减少内存要求和支持差异性,我们引入了我们的神经渲染代用(第3.2节),该代用将路径的样本信息编码为压缩、连续和可区分的表示,使艺术指导编辑和基因再光等应用成为可能。

blocks.en: 3.1 Decoupled Rendering
blocks.zh: 3.1 脱钩制作

blocks.en:
Virtual light sources are popular in production rendering because they allow adding emission to a scene without introducing undesired scattering effects—when a virtual light is intersected, its emission is added to the image, but the ray continues unaltered.
Since the construction of paths is therefore unaffected by the placement of light sources, we can re-order the computations carried out by a path tracer without altering the result.
Traditionally, path tracing interleaves the intersection of virtual lights and the computation of their emission with the path generation process ( 2(a) ).
In our approach, we split the computation into two passes ( 2(b) ):
blocks.zh:
虚拟光源在生产渲染中很受欢迎,因为它们允许向场景增加排放,而不引入不受欢迎的散射效应——当虚拟光被相接时,其释放会被添加到图像中,但射线继续未变.
由于路径的构造因此不会被光源的放置所影响,因此我们可以在不改变结果的情况下重新排序由路径跟踪器进行的计算.
传统上,路径跟踪会让虚拟光与路径生成过程(2(a))相交并计算其排放.
在我们的方法中,我们把计算分为两个通(2(b)):

blocks.en:
( SamplePaths ) samples paths and accumulates path vertex positions and their corresponding throughput weights for a given originating pixel.
This pass absorbs the most expensive components of the rendering process: the cost of loading the scene, intersecting rays with its geometry, and evaluating shaders.
Since it does not require any information about the light sources, the aggregated data can be reused to render various different lighting configurations.
blocks.zh:
(SamplePaths )对路径进行采样并积累路径顶点位置及其对应的给定原始像素的吞吐量权重.
这个传出吸收了渲染过程中最昂贵的组件:装入场景的成本,与它的几何相交的射线,以及评价阴影.
由于它不需要任何关于光源的信息,所以汇总数据可以被再利用来制作出各种不同的照明配置.

blocks.en:
( GatherLight ) uses the path samples to test each segment for intersection with virtual lights.
When a light is intersected, its emission is weighted by the throughput weight at the current vertex and simply added to the image.
Utilizing the high memory bandwidths of GPUs, this relighting process can be carried out at interactive rates without requiring advanced acceleration structures.
However, this pass requires storing large sample dumps alongside each render, typically weighing dozens of gigabytes per frame, which can quickly become prohibitive, e.g., when relighting of entire animation sequences is desired.
blocks.zh:
(GatherLight )使用路径样本测试每个段与虚拟灯相接.
当一盏光被相交时,其排放会被当下顶点的吞吐量重量所加权,并简单地被加入图像.
利用GPU的高内存带宽,这种再光过程可以在不需要高级加速结构的情况下以交互速率进行.
然而,这一通路需要将大型样品堆放场与每个渲染物相并存,通常每个帧重达数十千兆字节,这可能会很快变得令人望而却步,例如当需要重新点亮整个动画序列时.

blocks.en:
To ensure that GatherLight can produce unbiased renders for novel lighting configurations, SamplePaths needs to sample all possible directions that could intersect a light.
Fortunately, illumination-unaware sampling techniques such as BSDF sampling fulfill this requirement.
Similarly, techniques such as Russian roulette can be employed to reduce the number of path samples, and hence the computational cost of GatherLight .
However, our method does not benefit from illumination-aware techniques such as next event estimation (NEE) or path guiding, as these require knowledge of the light configuration at path generation time.
In practice, the noise of the generated image depends on the number of segments that intersect with the virtual light. This means that very small light sources as well as lights located in sparsely sampled scene regions can be challenging for our approach. We discuss our mitigation for this issue further in Section 4.4 .
blocks.zh:
为了确保GatherLight能够产生无偏倚的为新颖的照明配置而作的构件,SamplePaths需要对所有可能相交的光线方向进行取样.
所幸的是,BSDF取样等照明-无光能取样技术满足了这一要求。
同样,可以采用俄罗斯轮盘等技术来减少路径样品的数量,从而降低GatherLight的计算成本。
然而,我们的方法并没有从下个事件估计(NEE)或路径引导等发光感知技术中受益,因为这些技术需要在路径生成时间了解光的配置.
在实践中,所生成的图像的噪声取决于与虚拟光相交的片段数量. 这意味着位于采样稀少的景区极小的光源和灯光对我们的方法可能具有挑战性。 我们将在第4.4节中进一步讨论我们如何缓解这一问题。

blocks.en:
Our method naturally extends to volumes that can be rendered through analogous free-flight sampling techniques, including both homogeneous and heterogeneous volumes with arbitrary phase functions, but excludes volumes with spectrally varying densities.
Free-flight sampling techniques, such as delta tracking or analog decomposition tracking [ KHLN17 ] , distribute scattering distances according to transmittance, which cancels out changes to the throughput weight that would otherwise be required when intersecting an object within the volume.
Since such methods do not require light source locations, and all information about transmittance is fully contained in the distribution of path segments, GatherLight naturally extends to volumetric effects rendering without any alterations.
blocks.zh:
我们的方法自然延伸至通过类似的自由飞行取样技术可以提供的体积,包括具有任意相位功能的同质和相异体积,但不包括具有不同光谱密度的体积。
自由飞行采样技术,如三角洲跟踪或模拟分解跟踪[KHLN17],根据传输量分配散射距离,取消在体积内一个物体相接时需要的吞吐量重量变化。
由于这些方法不需要光源位置,而且所有关于传输的信息都完全包含在路径段的分布中,"GatherLight"自然地延伸到了不作任何修改的音量效应渲染.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Qualitative image-based relighting comparison. Our relighting setting matches that of image-based relighting using generative networks. Two leading approaches with similar input settings (image, auxiliary features, and lighting condition) are presented. Generative models do not preserve scene geometry, do not adhere to material appearance behavior, and produce lighting that is plausible, but is not physically reasonable. Our method produces high-quality and high-fidelity appearance in real-time. Note that the aspect ratio is different since the generative models used consider squared images.

blocks.en: 3.2 Differentiable Neural Render Proxy
blocks.zh: 3.2 可分化的神经电源代理

The number of input parameters to our neural networks greatly depends on the types of light sources to be rendered.
We have observed that our method works best for lights with lower parameter counts, such as sphere lights (four parameters: 3D position, radius) or quad lights (eight parameters: 3D position, 3D normal, width and height).
Generalizing to more complex types, such as area lights of arbitrary shapes or textured lights, remains a question for further investigation.

blocks.en:
Replacing GatherLight by a neural network not only drastically reduces the storage requirements (typically from gigabytes to megabytes), but also converts an otherwise non-differentiable function to a differentiable one.
This makes our model an effective surrogate for the full renderer, which we exploit for applications such as art-directed edits to light configurations (see Section 6.2 ) and harnessing generative models for automatic lighting of scenes (see Section 6.3 ).
blocks.zh:
由神经网络取而代之的GatherLight不仅会大幅降低存储要求(通常从千兆字节到兆字节),而且会将原本无差别的函数转换为可分函数.
这使得我们的模型成为了全渲染器的有效代用器,我们利用它来进行应用,例如将艺术编辑用于光线配置(见第6.2节),并利用基因模型自动照明场景(见第6.3节)。

We have implemented the neural render proxy described in Section 3 on top of PyTorch and tiny-cuda-nn [ Mül21 ] .
The overall process is depicted in Figure 1 .

blocks.en: 4.1 Path data caching
blocks.zh: 4.1 路径数据缓存

blocks.en: We collect path data by rendering the scene offline once in a light-agnostic pass as described in the SamplePaths step in Section 3.1 : Paths are traced from the camera following BSDF importance sampling without NEE, applying throughput-based Russian roulette. For production scenes we use Walt Disney Animation Studios’ CPU production renderer Hyperion [ BAC∗18 ] , while academic scenes are rendered with Mitsuba 3 [ JSR∗22 ] . For each path vertex, we store its 3D position and the throughput weight, along with the direction for paths that escape the scene without hitting geometry. Importantly, this caching requires no intrusive or algorithmic modifications to a standard Monte Carlo path tracer. In production renderers, existing path recording structures such as those used for path guiding [ HSRM25 ] can be repurposed directly. In our experiments with production scenes at a resolution of 960 × \times 402 with 512 samples per pixel (spp), rendering the path data took ∼ \sim 30 minutes including scene loading, using 32 threads of an Intel Xeon Gold 6342 at 2.8 GHz. The memory footprint of these scenes during rendering was between 14 and 28 GB of RAM. The complete details are included in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 我们收集路径数据的方式是,将场景一次在轻度不可知的通道中脱线,正如样板Paths第3.1节所描述的: 路径从没有NEE的BSDF重要性采样之后的相机上被追踪出,应用了以吞吐量为基础的俄罗斯轮盘. 我们使用华特迪士尼动画工作室的CPU制作渲染器Hyperion[BAC*18], 对于每个路径顶点,我们存储它的3D位置和吞吐量的重量,同时保存那些在不撞击几何的情况下逃离场景的路径的方向. 重要的是,这种缓存不需要对标准的蒙特卡洛路径跟踪器进行侵入性或算法性修改。 在生产渲染器中,现有的路径记录结构,如用于路径引导[HSRM25]的路径记录结构,可以被直接重用. 在生产场景的实验中,在960×x\times 402的分辨率下,每像素(spp)有512个样本,使路径数据花费了 \ sim 30分钟,包括场景加载,使用一个Intel Xeon Gold 6342的32个线程在2.8 GHz. 这些场景在渲染过程中的记忆足迹为RAM的14至28GB. 详细情况载于附录。

blocks.en: 4.2 GPU-accelerated reconstruction
blocks.zh: 4.2 GPU加速重建

blocks.en: The GatherLight step described in Section 3.1 requires testing millions of path segments for intersection, which can severely bottleneck performance if implemented naively. We thus implement a single fused Triton kernel [ TKC19 ] that evaluates all segments uniformly in one pass.
blocks.zh: 第3.1节所描述的"GatherLight"步骤需要测试数百万个路段来进行相交,如果天真地执行,这可能会严重地瓶颈性能. 因此,我们实施一个单一的被保险的Triton内核[TKC19],在一个通道中统一评价所有部分。

blocks.en: We pack the dataset into an interleaved representation, storing geometry in half-precision ( fp16 ) and HDR color throughput in rgb9e5 , a 32-bit shared-exponent floating-point format that captures the full HDR range of path throughputs while saving 8 bytes per segment compared to a standard float32 RGB triple. This layout lets the path data for a render of 960 × 402 960\times 402 at 512 spp or, equivalently, 1920 × 804 1920\times 804 at 128 spp, both with up to 6 segments per path, fit comfortably in consumer GPU memory.
blocks.zh: 我们把数据集打包成一个相接的表示式,以半精度(fp16)和HDR的颜色吞吐量以rgb9e5来存储几何,这是一种32位的共享-激发活性浮点格式,它捕捉到路径吞吐量的全部HDR范围,同时与标准浮点32的RGB三相比较,每段节省了8个字节. 这种布局使960×402 960\times 402的渲染量的路径数据在512 spp上,或等同地,1920×804 1920\times 804 at 128 spp上,每条路径的渲染量可达6个段,在消费者GPU内存中适得其反.

blocks.en: 4.3 Network architecture
blocks.zh: 4.3 网络架构

blocks.en:
Beyond the parameters of the light source, our networks accept nine further inputs: the pixel coordinates px (2D) and pixel features F px F_{\text{px}} (albedo + depth + normal, 7D).
The outputs of the networks are the contribution of the light as described in Equation 2 , which are multiplied with the light emission E E and summed up to give the final pixel value I ^ px \hat{I}_{\text{px}} .
blocks.zh:
除了光源的参数外,我们的网络接受另外9个输入:像素坐标为px(2D),像素特征为Fpx FQQText{px}}(albedo + 深度+正态,7D).
网络的输出是"方程式2"所描述的光能的贡献,与光能排放 E E相乘,并被概括为给出了最终像素值 I^ px\hat{I}_{\text{px}.

blocks.en:
The pixel coordinates px are encoded by a two-dimensional multi-resolution hashgrid [ MESK22 ] , which we have found helps the network to learn sharper discontinuities in image space (e.g., shadow edges).
We have experimented with encodings for the other inputs, but have found little benefit in them.
blocks.zh:
像素坐标px被二维多分辨率的散列网[MESK22]编码,我们发现这帮助网络在图像空间(如阴影边缘)中学习更尖锐的不连续.
我们试验了其他投入的编码,但发现这些投入没有什么好处。

blocks.en: 4.4 Training
blocks.zh: 4.4 培训

blocks.en: For each training batch, we sample random light parameters for each pixel px and construct the desired target pixel values via path data gathering. We then compute the loss between the predicted output of our network and the target output. With a standard configuration (a × 680 680\!\times\!680 -pixel scene at 512 spp and a network of 8 layers with 256 neurons), we train our neural proxy for 100k iterations, taking approximately 1 hour on an NVIDIA RTX 5090 (32 GB VRAM). Robust training, however, requires careful design of the light parameter sampling strategy, the loss function, and the mitigation of excessive noise in the training data. To address the latter, we denoise pixels using an off-the-shelf interactive denoiser, as described below.
blocks.zh: 对于每批训练,我们抽取每个像素px的随机光参数,并通过路径数据收集构建所期望的目标像素值. 然后计算我们网络的预测输出与目标输出之间的损失. 通过标准配置(a × 680 680\!\times\ !680-像素场景位于512 spp并有8层有256个神经元的网络),我们为100k重迭训练我们的神经代名词,在NVIDIA RTX 5090(32 GB VRAM)上大约需要1小时. 然而,强力训练需要仔细设计光参数采样策略,损失功能,并缓解训练数据中的过度噪音. 为了处理后者,我们用现成的交互式像素来表示像素,如下所述。

blocks.en:
While it is possible to reconstruct individual pixel values I px I_{\text{px}} for any light configuration through gathering, we found the noise of the reconstructed values for small light sources to be prohibitive for effective network training.
To combat this, we incorporate an interactive denoiser [ Áfr26 ] in our training pipeline. This denoiser uses the same auxiliary features used by the network itself ( Section 4.3 ) to better preserve geometrical edges. However, utilizing a denoiser forces us to use the same light parameters across all pixels, which heavily limits lighting diversity in a single batch and hinders the training process.
To mitigate this, we keep a pool of denoised images for various light configurations in memory, and for each pixel sample uniformly from this pool.
In all our experiments, we use an image pool of size 300, and replace 2 images every 5 iterations of training.
This replacement strategy ensures adequate coverage of the domain of possible light configurations.
blocks.zh:
虽然通过集合可以重建单个像素值 I px I_{\text{px}}} 任何光线配置,但我们发现重建后的光源值的噪音对于有效的网络训练来说是令人望而却步的.
为了与这种情况作斗争,我们把一个互动的Denoiser[Áfr26]纳入我们的训练管道。 这个denoiser使用网络本身使用的同一种辅助特征(第4.3节)来更好地保存几何边缘. 然而,使用"出自"(denoiser)迫使我们在所有像素上使用相同的光参数,这严重限制了一批的照明多样性并阻碍了训练过程.
为了缓解这种情况,我们保留了一组用于各种光线配置的去诺化图像在记忆中,并且对于来自这个池的每一个像素样本,都是统一的.
在所有的实验中,我们使用一个大小为300的图像池,并更换每5个迭代训练的2个图像.
这种替换战略确保了可能的光配置域的充分覆盖.

blocks.en:
To pick a random light position for a given pixel px , we use different strategies depending on the characteristics of the scene. For smaller scenes, we uniformly pick among our recorded path segments for that pixel, and then choose a random point uniformly on that segment. This implicitly importance samples positions that have higher contribution to the image (e.g., are closer to the camera or strongly reflected by objects), and avoid positions that do not contribute to any pixel in the image (e.g., lights within closed objects).
However, some of our tested production scenes are gigantic in scale and only a tiny fraction is directly visible from the camera. In such cases, segment-based sampling can produce suboptimal training candidates, causing the network to allocate capacity to regions where lights are unlikely to be placed during inference. As a practical remedy for such scenes, we instead sample uniformly within the bounding box of all positions visible from the camera. More sophisticated sampling schemes could be explored in future work.
blocks.zh:
要为给定的像素px选择随机光线位置,我们根据场景的特点使用不同的策略. 对于较小的场景,我们统一选择我们所记录的路径段来表示这个像素,然后在该段上统一选择一个随机点. 这种隐含重要性的样本位置对图像有较高贡献(例如更接近相机或被物体强烈地反映),并避免对图像中任何像素不起作用的位置(例如闭合物体内的灯光).
然而,我们测试过的一些生产场景规模巨大,从相机上直接可见的只有一小部分. 在这种情况下,基于分块的取样可以产生不理想的培训候选人,导致网络将能力分配给那些在推论中不大可能放置灯光的区域。 作为这些场景的实际补救,我们用相机可见的所有位置的相框内统一取样。 在今后的工作中可以探讨更复杂的取样计划。

blocks.en: 5.1 Path-based Sampling
blocks.zh: 5.1 基于路径的取样

blocks.en:
Our method trains on path data from a light-agnostic rendering pass from which arbitrary light configurations can be evaluated on-the-fly. This allows the network to see a far greater variety of lighting conditions than any pre-rendered image dataset of comparable size.
To validate this advantage, in Figure 5 , we compare against an image-based baseline where networks are trained on datasets of rendered images with NEE and multiple importance sampling, using light configurations sampled from the same distribution as our method.
We evaluate two settings: (1) a varying number of 1 spp images (64 to 1024), and (2) a constant rendering budget of 1024 total sampled paths per pixel, distributed across different numbers of images (e.g., 32 images at 32 spp, 512 images at 2 spp).
Note that our path-based approach uses 64 spp, so the constant-budget setting represents a 16 × \times higher render time.
blocks.zh:
我们的方法在路径数据上从轻而易举的渲染通过,从此任意的光能配置可以在飞行时得到评价. 这使得网络能够比任何预发的可比较大小的图像数据集看到更多种类的照明条件.
为了验证这一优势,在图5中,我们比较了一个基于图像的基准,即网络通过NEE和多重重要性取样,利用从与我们方法相同的分布中抽取的光配置来培训成像的数据集。
我们评价两种设置:(1)1 spp图像的不同数量(64至1024),(2)每像素的恒定渲染预算为1024个总采样路径,分布在不同数量的图像上(例如32 spp的32个图像,2 spp的512个图像).

blocks.en: We report the PSNR in tonemapped space, averaged across three scenes and evaluated on 500 validation images whose light configurations are sampled from the same distribution used during training. Our method outperforms all image-based configurations by a significant margin. Even with 1024 training images, the image-based baseline remains 2.8 dB below ours. The constant-budget ablation further shows that redistributing a larger rendering budget across fewer, higher-quality images does not close the gap. This confirms that the key advantage of our approach is not the total rendering cost, but the ability to reuse path data across many light configurations during training, providing the network with far richer supervision over the light transport distribution of the scene than a fixed dataset of images can offer.

blocks.en: 5.2 Training & Network Architecture
blocks.zh: 5.2 培训和网络结构

blocks.en: We evaluate the effect of samples per pixel (spp) in the training path data. Figure 6 shows prediction quality and the denoised reconstruction from the GatherLight pass across four metrics, averaged over three scenes. Increasing spp improves both reconstruction and prediction quality. Notably, at low spp (32 and 64), the network outperforms the denoised reconstruction. Since the denoiser operates independently per frame, it introduces temporal flickering across light configurations. The network, trained under many lighting conditions, learns a temporally smooth approximation of the scene’s light transport. At higher spp, reconstruction noise diminishes and the denoised reference surpasses the network, whose finite capacity limits its ability to capture all high-frequency detail.

blocks.en: Table 2 reports the effect of three components, which is visualized in an example in the supplemental material: auxiliary features (albedo, normals, depth), denoising the reconstruction targets at training, and a hashgrid encoding for pixel coordinates. The hashgrid encoding alone degrades performance by enabling overfitting to high-frequency noise patterns. blocks.en: In order to evaluate our method in inverse rendering tasks for lighting, we compare it against Mitsuba 3 [ JSR∗22 ] , an academic differentiable renderer, and ZeroGrads [ FR24 ] , a neural proxy method for black-box renderers. Note that Mitsuba 3 is a general-purpose differentiable renderer with gradients computed from the proper light transport of the scene. This evaluation does not intend to claim a superiority over real physically-based inverse renderers, but just to validate our method as an alternative when these renderers are not available, like in the context of complex production path tracers that drive our problem.
blocks.zh: 为了评价我们反向渲染照明任务的方法,我们把它和Mitsuba 3[JSR*22]比较,后者是一个学术上不同的渲染器,而ZeroGrads[FR24]则是黑盒渲染器的一种神经代用方法. 请注意,Mitsuba 3是一种通用的可分化的可变变相器,其梯度是根据场景的适当光传输来计算的. 这种评价并不打算声称比实际的反向渲染器优越,而只是为了在不具备这些渲染器时验证我们的方法作为替代方法,例如在造成我们问题的复杂生产路径跟踪器的背景下。

blocks.en: We perform 50 optimization runs per scene (Cornell Box, Bedroom, and Kitchen) with a single light and randomly sampled initial and target parameters. All methods run for 500 iterations with Adam (lr=0.05). ZeroGrads uses a fixed 8 spp throughout, training its neural proxy on-the-fly with a proxy learning rate of 0.001 and batch size 4. For both baselines, we use DrJIT’s @dr.freeze decorator to eliminate JIT recompilation overhead and report only the effective computation time.

blocks.en: Our method does not require samples per pixel as it uses a pre-trained NRP, whereas Mitsuba 3 requires progressively increasing spp for variance reduction, and ZeroGrads requires additional hyperparameters for proxy learning. In contrast to our method, which operates on a finite set of precached paths, ZeroGrads can be run in a streaming fashion, progressively increasing accuracy at the expense of additional computation. Being non-progressive is a deliberate design choice in our approach that avoids loading bulky production scenes; incorporating progressive streams remains a promising direction for future work. blocks.en: 6 Applications
blocks.zh: 6 申请

blocks.en: Differentiable NRPs can be leveraged for many lighting paradigms. We demonstrate three applications enabled by the compact, differentiable nature of NRPs.
blocks.zh: 不同的NRP可用于许多照明模式。 我们演示了三种由紧凑的、可区分的NRP性质的应用。

blocks.en: 6.1 Interactive relighting
blocks.zh: 6.1 交互式照明

blocks.en: First, NRP is immediately applicable in relighting applications: Given a lighting configuration, the NRP predicts the contribution of each light source to the final image pixels. As demonstrated in our experiments, the NRP network provides more accurate renderings compared to generative image-based relighting networks ( Figure 4 ). NRPs scale gracefully to production scenes ( Figure 3 ) with complex geometry and radiometry. Our method supports relighting of volumes with spectrally non-varying extinction coefficients, and supports virtual spherical lights and virtual quad lights (Figure 12 ).
blocks.zh: 首先,NRP立即适用于重燃应用程序: 鉴于一个照明配置,NRP预测每个光源对最终图像像素的贡献. 正如我们的实验所表明的那样,NRP网络提供比以基因图像为基础的再照网络更准确的渲染(图4 )。 NRPs以复杂的几何和辐射来优雅地缩放到生产场景(图3). 我们的方法支持以光谱上非变异的灭绝系数来重燃体积,并支持虚拟球形光和虚拟四相光(图12.

blocks.en: Second, since the NRP network is compact, unlike most neural methods, separate NRPs for different views can be loaded simultaneously into memory. This is particularly useful in production multi-view setups, where several cameras capture the same scene from different viewpoints. Traditionally, every lighting edit would need to be applied and re-rendered independently for each view. With NRPs, however, each light edit can be applied interactively and consistently across all views simultaneously (see Figure 9 ). Similar applications for simultaneous lighting editing across entire sequences are thinkable, but have not been explored in this work.
blocks.zh: 第二,由于NRP网络是紧凑的,与大多数神经方法不同,针对不同观点的独立NRP可以被同时装入内存. 这在生产多视图设置中特别有用,其中多台相机从不同的角度捕捉出同场景. 传统上,每个照明编辑都需要应用,每个视图需要独立重新投放. 但是,有了NRPs,每个光线编辑可以交互和一致地同时在所有视图中应用(见图9)。 在整个序列中同时进行照明编辑的类似应用是可思考的,但在本作中并未被探索.

blocks.en: Third, our approach can be seamlessly combined with compositing workflows; separate NRPs can be trained on separately rendered layers of a scene, allowing us to edit the lighting of individual layers without affecting other layers (Figure 10 ).
blocks.zh: 第三,我们的方法可以与堆肥工作流程无缝地结合;单独的NRP可以被训练在一个场景的分出层上,使我们能够编辑单个层的照明而不影响其他层(图10.

blocks.en: 6.2 Art-directed edits
blocks.zh: 6.2 艺术指导编辑

blocks.en: The differentiability of NRPs admits their use in optimization-based lighting edits, such as image-space shading target matching (see Figure 8 ) and art-directed “light scribbling” (see Figure 11 , left). In this workflow, artists paint color scribbles directly onto the rendered image to indicate desired lighting changes, and the optimizer adjusts the underlying light parameters to match them. Constraint masks can be applied to preserve existing pixel values in regions the artist does not wish to modify, ensuring that only the targeted areas are affected. This combination of intuitive painting controls and automatic parameter recovery enables rapid iterative workflows, particularly suited for live sessions between lighting supervisors and lighting artists.
blocks.zh: NRP的相异性承认它们被用于以优化为基础的照明编辑,如图像空间遮蔽目标匹配(见图8)和艺术导向"轻打"(见图11,左侧). 在这个工作流程中,艺术家直接将彩色拼图画到被渲染的图像上来表示所期望的照明变化,而优化器会调整所基于的光参数来相匹配. 在艺术家不愿修改的地区,可以使用约束口罩来保存现有的像素值,确保只影响目标区域。 这种直观绘画控制和自动参数恢复的结合使得能快速地迭接工作流程,特别适合照明主管和照明艺术家之间的直播会话.

blocks.en: 6.3 Optimization with generative targets
blocks.zh: 6.3 优化基因目标

blocks.en: Generative image models can produce compelling lighting variations, but their outputs are not guaranteed to be physically plausible and do not provide the underlying light parameters needed for integration into a production pipeline. By using a generated image as an optimization target, our method recovers a close physically plausible lighting configuration along with its explicit parameters, bridging the gap between generative creativity and physically-based rendering. Figure 11 (right) presents qualitative results demonstrating this capability, utilizing target images generated by Qwen-Image-Edit [ WLZ∗25 ] .
blocks.zh: 遗传图像模型可产生令人信服的照明变化,但其产出不能保证在物理上是可信的,不能提供融入生产管道所需的基本光参数。 通过使用生成的图像作为优化目标,我们的方法恢复了贴近物理上可行的照明配置及其明确的参数,弥合了基因创造力和物理渲染力之间的差距。 图11 (右) 利用由Quen-Image-Edit[WLZ*25]生成的目标图像,显示了这种能力的定性结果。

blocks.en: 7 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 7 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en:
While our model in principle generalizes to arbitrary types of light sources, their respective parameter counts directly impact the training convergence and accuracy of our neural render proxy.
We therefore leave complex light sources, such as textured lights or area lights of arbitrary shapes, as future work.
blocks.zh:
虽然我们的模型原则上泛指任意类型的光源,但是它们各自的参数直接影响到我们神经成像代理的训练趋同和准确性。
因此,我们留下复杂的光源,例如纹理灯或任意形状的区域灯,作为未来的工作。

blocks.en: Another limitation is that our approach assumes that the light transport between any objects remains constant after rendering. Commonly used tools in the arsenal of lighters, like non-physical light-attenuation between objects or light-exclusivity for certain objects, cannot be changed after the NRP was trained. While per-layer NRPs can be used to somewhat mimic light-exclusivity, it comes at the price of training multiple NRPs.
blocks.zh: 另一个限制是,我们的方法假定任何物体之间的光传输在渲染后保持不变。 在打火机的武库中常用的工具,如物体之间的非物理光能增强或某些物体的光能排斥等,在NRP训练后无法被改变. 虽然每个层的NRP可以用来在一定程度上模仿光-排斥性,但它是以训练多层NRP为代价的.

blocks.en:
Additionally, our training relies on a light-agnostic path sampling strategy.
We currently employ material-based sampling, which produces training data with similar throughput weight to the camera.
However, this can lead to under-sampling in occluded regions where a user might later wish to place a light source. For instance, in Figure 13 , the region inside the lamp shade is under-sampled since no NEE was used during path sample generation, which leads to inaccurate predictions.
Investigating different sampling strategies during data generation that deliberately increase the sampling density of locations where a user might add light sources could yield significant improvements in quality.
blocks.zh:
此外,我们的培训依赖于轻度不可知路径取样战略。
我们目前采用基于材料的取样方法,生成与相机相似的吞吐重量的培训数据。
然而,这可能导致在用户后来可能希望放出光源的被占用地区进行抽样不足。 例如,在图13中,灯荫内的区域没有受到充分采样,因为在路径采样过程中没有使用NEE,这导致了不准确的预测。
在数据生成过程中调查各种取样策略,这些策略有意提高用户可能增加光源的地点的取样密度,可以大大提高质量。

blocks.en:
Finally, our training pipeline is constrained by the available GPU memory, as all path-sample data is pre-loaded.
While this enables on-the-fly generation of denoised training targets, it limits the number of samples and the quality of our training data.
Future research could investigate out-of-core training schedules that allow on-demand loading of path data from disk during training, or partitioning of the predicted image.
blocks.zh:
最后,我们的培训管道受到可用的GPU内存的限制,因为所有路径样本数据都是被预装的.
虽然这可以使培训目标在飞机上产生,但它限制了样本的数量和我们培训数据的质量。
未来的研究可以调查核心之外的培训时间表,以便在培训期间按需从磁盘上装入路径数据,或将预测的图像分割。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: Interactive, physically grounded lighting design on production scenes has been limited by the cost of path tracing, trapping artists in a slow cycle of parameter adjustment and re-rendering. The neural render proxy removes this bottleneck: A single light-agnostic rendering pass produces a compact, differentiable model that enables real-time forward relighting with full parametric precision, independent of scene complexity. Its differentiability further unlocks a new mode of creative control that production pipelines have traditionally lacked: Image-space objectives from art direction, paint-overs, or generative models are translated via gradient descent into the lighting parameters that produce them. Production scenes thus become interactively relightable and inversely designable through a single representation, with every edit grounded in a physical, editable, and reusable set of light configurations.
blocks.zh: 制作场景上的互动性,实体化的照明设计受到了路径追踪成本的限制,将艺术家困入了缓慢的参数调整和回放周期. 神经渲染代理删除了这个瓶颈: 单光不可知的渲染传出一个紧凑而相异的模型,能够以全参数精度,独立于场景复杂性的实时前发光. 其差异性进一步打开了生产管道传统上缺乏的新型创造性控制模式: 由艺术取向、涂料或基因模型产生的图像空间目标通过梯度下降转化为产生它们的照明参数。 因此,制作场景通过单一的表示方式变得可交互地可再光和反向地设计,每部编辑都以一组实际的、可编辑的和可再使用的光线配置为基础。
